title: 第1712章 我笑你就知道吹牛第1711章 强盗
lines: 随着时间的不断推移。
两位仙王强盗发现他们联手，却是迟迟无法顺利斩杀仙船仙王，继续这样下去的话，对于他们来说绝对是极其不利的事情。
可惜的是，越是着急，越是无法顺利斩杀。
“所有人撤退。”
不管他们是否愿意相信，这种情况下，他们继续斗下去已经毫无意义的事情。
他们是想要抢夺仙船，而不是丢掉性命，这是他们无法接受的事情。
看着远去的身影，众人都是唏嘘不已。
这次仙船死伤无数，对于仙船来说，损失极大。
“立刻全力飞行，以最快的速度赶往葬古仙域。”
同样得到消息的三人，也算是松了口气，他们本身已经做好随时离开的准备，因为他们都很清楚，要是仙船被强行破开，对于他们来说到底意味着什么。
“真是难以置信的事情，以一敌二的情况下，仙船竟然顺利抗下来了。”
黑天有种死里逃生的劫后余生，毕竟一般情况下，仙船要是遇到强盗的话，后果不堪设想。
想到这里的众人都是唏嘘不已。
“我要是没有猜错的话，接下来仙船会开足马力，全力赶往葬古仙域。”
“林兄弟，接下来的这段时间，你不要随意离开住处。”
“我明白。”
等到两人离开后，林铮也没有继续离开半步，他可不想给自己招惹麻烦。
接下来的十来天时间，仙船的船市和黑市等全部暂停，终于顺利的来到葬古仙域，到现在所有人才算是真正松口气。
船票贵，有贵的道理。
毕竟同时面对两位仙王强盗，仙船完全顺利抗了下来，要是换做弱一些的仙船，相信这次算是彻底栽了。
离开仙船，林铮狠狠的伸了个懒腰。
黑天笑着说道：“这次也算是有惊无险，林兄弟，我们也要告辞了，你要是有时间，可以来我青凰宫找我们。”
看着离去的身影，轻灵皱着眉头，说道：“林铮是个人才，要是能够顺利拉拢，也是不错的事情。”
“我明白你的意思，只是他的修为太低，就算是由我们两人引荐，等到进入宗门后，依然会遭受轻视，毫无意义的事情。”
“算了，我们先回去。”
离开后的林铮，元神传音问道：“鸢姐，我们现在便赶往幽阙宫？”
“没问题。”
林铮当然能看的出来，沈烟鸢很是着急，他也没有丝毫的犹豫和怠慢，立刻朝着沈烟鸢给的坐标位置快速而去。
要是能够找到幽阙宫这样的靠山，相信对于自己来说，也是极其不错的事情。
按照坐标位置，自己现在距离幽阙宫太远，几乎是一南一北，短时间内肯定是无法赶过去。
而林铮惊讶的发现，葬古仙域蕴藏的仙力，要远远凌驾于天阳仙域之上，大概是四分之一左右，对于武者来说，绝对不是简简单单的四分之一。
‘你被盯上了’
猛然停下脚步的林铮显得很是惊讶，他很清楚沈烟鸢不可能无缘无故的如此说，想来自己肯定是被盯上了。
‘之前在仙船，想要你送出丹药的那个人’
‘黑牛’
黑牛，二重仙君境高手，原本是想要借刀杀人，拉着邬管事一起对付自己，他没有想到，黑天会突然站出来替自己作证，并且自己还直接送给邬管事一枚涅盘丹，使得邬管事根本不再多管闲事。
content_en:
As time goes by.
The two Immortal King Bandits found that they had joined forces, but they were still unable to successfully kill the Immortal Ship Immortal King. If this continued, it would definitely be extremely detrimental to them.
Unfortunately, the more anxious you are, the less likely you are to kill smoothly.
"Everyone retreat."
Regardless of whether they want to believe it or not, in this case, it is meaningless for them to continue fighting.
They wanted to rob the fairy ship, not lose their lives. This was something they could not accept.
Looking at the retreating figure, everyone was sighing.
This time the fairy ship suffered numerous casualties, which was a huge loss for the fairy ship.
"Fly with all your strength immediately and rush to the Ancient Burial Immortal Realm as quickly as possible."
"Yes."
The three people who also received the news were relieved. They were ready to leave at any time, because they all knew what it would mean to them if the fairy ship was forcibly broken open.
"It's really unbelievable. With one against two, the fairy ship successfully resisted."
Black Sky had the feeling of escaping death. After all, under normal circumstances, if the fairy ship encountered bandits, the consequences would be disastrous.
Everyone was in awe when thinking of this.
"If I guess correctly, the immortal ship will be at full speed and rush to the Ancient Burial Immortal Realm."
"Brother Lin, during the next period of time, please do not leave your residence at will."
"I understand."
After the two left, Lin Zheng did not leave even half a step further. He did not want to cause trouble for himself.
In the next ten days or so, the ship market and black market of the Immortal Ships were all suspended, and finally they successfully arrived at the Ancient Burial Immortal Realm. Only now can everyone truly breathe a sigh of relief.
Ferry tickets are expensive for a reason.
After all, facing two Immortal King bandits at the same time, the Immortal Ship successfully resisted. If it had been a weaker Immortal Ship, I believe it would have been completely defeated this time.
Leaving the fairy ship, Lin Zheng stretched hard.
Hei Tian smiled and said: "This time it is considered a near miss. Brother Lin, we have to say goodbye. If you have time, you can come to my Qinghuang Palace to find us."
"Okay."
Looking at the departing figure, Qing Ling frowned and said, "Lin Zheng is a talented person. It would be good if he can win over him smoothly."
"I understand what you mean, but his cultivation level is too low. Even if he is introduced by the two of us, he will still be despised when he enters the sect. It is meaningless."
"Forget it, let's go back first."
After Lin Zheng left, Yuan Shen sent a message and asked: "Sister Yuan, should we rush to Youque Palace now?"
"Yes."
"No problem."
Of course Lin Zheng could see that Shen Yanyuan was very anxious, and without any hesitation or hesitation, he immediately rushed towards the coordinates given by Shen Yanyuan.
If I could find a backer like Youque Palace, I believe it would be an extremely good thing for me.
According to the coordinate position, I am too far away from Youque Palace now, almost one south and one north, and I will definitely not be able to get there in a short time.
Lin Zheng was surprised to find that the immortal power contained in the Ancient Burial Immortal Realm was far superior to that of the Tianyang Immortal Realm, about a quarter. For a warrior, it was definitely not a simple quarter.
'You're being targeted'
‘Who? ’
Lin Zheng, who suddenly stopped, looked very surprised. He knew very well that Shen Yanyuan could not say that for no reason, and he must have been targeted.
‘The person who wanted you to send the elixir in the fairy ship before’
‘black cow’
Hei Niu, a master of the second level Immortal Lord Realm, originally wanted to kill someone with a borrowed knife, and pulled Guanshi Wu to deal with him. He did not expect that Hei Tian would suddenly stand up to testify for him, and he also directly gave Guanshi Wu a Nirvana Pill, so that Guanshi Wu would no longer meddle in his own business.
